title: Symmetric encoded edge relation
statement: For a Boolean string $x$ and natural number $n$, define the encoded edge relation to be symmetric on vertices below $n$ when, for every $u,v<n$, $u$ is an edge to $v$ exactly when $v$ is an edge to $u$.
caveat: The definition of $\mathrm{pathEdge}$ is absent, so the encoded edge relation cannot be explained more concretely from this snippet.
